_why: A seed identifies a reproducible IMAGE, not a PERSON. The 定妆 flow fixes a cast identity (subject) first, then derives each portrait image from it — so images reference a subject, never a seed. A seed on a character record is a coincidence that breaks the moment the art is regenerated.

style_block is the single style sentence for all character portraits. It must stay byte-identical to the 画风 section in design/30_presentation.md; changing one without the other desyncs the next portrait batch.
Non-character asset records (terrain, backdrop, audio) keep their seed/prompt fields in the assets array below — they are one-off generations with no subject layer.
style_block: Chinese wuxia game-art illustration with a deliberate SPLIT REGISTER: the head is fully cartoon (rounded simplified head-carapace, large expressive eyes with clear highlights, appealing, never scary); the body is semi-realistic (overlapping carapace plates, distinct segment joints, ridges and spines, clear directional light, soft shadow, glossy shell sheen)
